command: set -euo pipefail; docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait; export RICCON_TEST_SERVICES=external RICCON_TEST_SERVICES_NAMESPACE=m22verify; node scripts/test-services.mjs prepare --namespace "$RICCON_TEST_SERVICES_NAMESPACE"; find apps platform -type d -name surefire-reports -prune -exec rm -rf {} +; perl -e 'alarm shift; exec @ARGV' 2400 ./mvnw -q -T1C verify jacoco:report && pnpm -w test -- --coverage
note: M22 verifier 合同 commands.test+coverage（DEC-0022 共用一 EV）：external namespace m22verify，清空 surefire 后全量 verify jacoco:report + 前端 coverage；2400s 显式超时
